A1.justification: Both PDFs describe LALIC. Their complete main texts and supplementary Sections A-F, including equations, tables, and figures, are readable and can be matched across revisions and relocations.

before.justification: v1 reports original compression performance, computational measurements, architecture ablations, and analyses of receptive fields, latent representations, and reconstructed images.

after.justification: v2 retains original experiments and analyses, revises benchmark and ablation results, and adds cross-dataset MS-SSIM BD-rate results.

M1.justification: The Bi-RWKV transforms, RWKV-SCCTX procedure, quantization, and training objective remain unchanged. Section 3.3 explicitly excludes Omni-Shift from parameter aggregation, clarifying the pointwise, 1x1 operation already described and illustrated in v1 rather than establishing an algorithm change.

E1.justification: Both versions train on the first 400,000 OpenImages images and evaluate image compression on Kodak, Tecnick, and CLIC Professional Validation. The added MS-SSIM reporting uses existing dataset and task coverage.

E2.justification: Table 1 removes Minnen18-Spatial and adds Cheng20-Parallel, which already appeared in Figure 1 of v1. Minnen20-ChARM is renamed Minnen20 with unchanged results. The other principal comparison methods are retained.

E3.justification: The depth and entropy-model ablations switch from inference loss to BD-rate in v2 Table 2, and the 2,2,6,2 depth configuration is dropped. Appendix B adds MS-SSIM BD-rate assessment across the existing benchmarks. The stated main training schedule, dataset sizes, model configuration, and hardware remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The existing depth and entropy-model ablations are revised through BD-rate comparisons and removal of one depth configuration. Their research questions remain the same. Attention-component ablations, receptive-field and correlation analyses, scaling tests, and subjective examples are retained; several are merely relocated.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or run-to-run uncertainty. The reporting of point estimates and dataset averages is unchanged.

E6.justification: Reported results are substantially revised and extended. From v1 Table 5 to v2 Table 1, LALIC's PSNR BD-rates on Kodak/CLIC/Tecnick change from -14.84/-15.20/-17.32% to -15.26/-15.41/-17.63%. MLIC++ changes from -17.59% to -17.21% on Tecnick, reversing its ranking against LALIC. v2 also adds MS-SSIM BD-rates and replaces depth/context loss entries with BD-rate results. The PDFs do not explain the cause of every score revision.

T1.justification: Equations 1-8, the scaled-deviation definition, and Appendix C's attention-complexity calculations remain unchanged. The theoretical operation-count table is renumbered from Table 6 to Table 5 without substantive mathematical changes.

C1.justification: The abstract and contribution list revise quantitative performance claims, including claimed Kodak savings from 14.84% to 15.26%, and correct the association of CLIC and Tecnick with their reported values. The novelty, architectural contributions, and efficiency claims retain their scope.

C2.justification: Section 3.3 newly explains the pointwise aggregation requirement through causal decoding. Appendix B specifically attributes missing MS-SSIM comparisons to unavailable optimized models or curves. The high-resolution/global-context interpretation moves into Section 4.2 but is not new.

D1.justification: v2 supplies a code-repository link, states that comparison points come from available checkpoints or published curves, and clarifies omission of Omni-Shift in aggregation. Figure 4 newly labels the aggregation repetition count as three. These are documentation additions, not demonstrated implementation changes.

R1.justification: v2 adds four dataset/source references for OpenImages, Kodak, Tecnick, and CLIC. The related-work discussion and positioning relative to transformer, Mamba, and RWKV approaches remain substantively unchanged.

P1.justification: There are localized abstract and results rewrites, reordered ablation discussions, relocation of the high-resolution interpretation from the appendix, and a new acknowledgment section. Most methodological and related-work prose remains intact.

P2.justification: Table 1 incorporates the appendix's three-dataset PSNR comparisons, and Table 2 consolidates depth and context ablations. Appendix B receives an MS-SSIM table. Figure 4 is redrawn, plot labels and colors are revised, Figures 8 and 9 are exchanged and relocated, and the subjective-comparison layout is compacted. These are targeted display changes within the existing document design.

improvement.justification: v2 improves empirical reporting and reproducibility through cross-dataset MS-SSIM results, corrected abstract dataset associations, a code link, and clearer aggregation details. The benefit is limited by incomplete reconciliation: Section 4.4 still describes loss and consistently improving depth, although Table 2 reports BD-rates of -2.50% and -1.68% for successive deeper configurations. The conclusion also retains the superseded -14.84% Kodak figure.
